'This Golden Week' means 1-7 Oct 2026. 'Briefly' is the source's own word (短暫實施); on 4 Oct, Rua de S. Paulo was one-way uphill from 13:50 to 15:10 (Macao Daily News, 5 Oct 2026). It is a general mechanism from a 1991 New York case, never a Macau event: no crush injury at these sites was found for 2024-2026, so the body diagram is drawn off the map and the citation names the case. Keep 'National Day holiday record' whole: the all-time daily record is 248,000 on 2 May 2026 (brief-evidence.md, section 1), so 'record day' or 'Golden Week record' would be false. 210,000 counts visitor arrivals to all of Macau, not people at the Ruins.

Say 'named', never 'signed in', 'verified' or 'authenticated'. 'The department running it': brief-evidence.md, section 6, 'Responsibility (for discussion, not settled)': under Law 8/2005 the operating department would be the data controller; the police hold the duty for pedestrian movement (Law 14/2018, Art. 3); 'to be confirmed with the authorities' stays in the footer. 'Every notice says an AI forecast is involved': AI_NOTICE in backend/app/services/intervention.py is appended to every non-empty notice in zh, en and pt (en: 'Advice from an AI crowd forecast, approved by staff.'; test test_public_notices_say_ai_is_involved_and_staff_approved); its zh and pt wording awaits a fluent team member's check before S04 is captured. Row 1 keeps the hedge 'may be more vulnerable' (brief-evidence.md, section 5, 'At-risk groups': Motomura 2019 'may', Chowhan 2026 'face heightened risks'); no wheelchair-specific evidence was found (section 8), so wheelchair users appear only inside 'less mobile'; 'visitors who can't read Chinese' is the team's design reasoning (docs/model-card.md, 'Fairness considerations'), not a cited finding. Row 3's sign is a plan (draft trilingual sign, brief-evidence.md, section 6) and always carries '(planned)'. notes: Four-member team: M3 says the 'Next' line. Timing: 20 words + 3 hand-offs + 1 s together in 11.0 s (guide 9.4 s without hand-offs). If the real take overruns, apply cut 5: drop the separate all-together second (the wide shot already holds everyone); never cut a line. The adult supervisor may appear in the wide shot but does not speak. Authorities (brief-evidence.md, section 6): the police hold the legal duty for pedestrian movement (Law 14/2018). Images of identifiable people are personal data under Law 8/2005, Art. 4(1)(1), so the Personal Data Protection Bureau's view comes first; if the phones counted as a video-surveillance system under Law 2/2012, the Chief Executive's authorisation after a binding opinion from that bureau would also apply. Whether the Municipal Affairs Bureau must license the mounts (Reg. Adm. 28/2004) is for that bureau to confirm.
